definitions.explanation: Expresses strong desire or recommendation. Used to strongly encourage someone or express earnest hope.

examples.japanese: ぜひ{食|た}べてみてください。
examples.english: You really should try eating this.

examples.japanese: ぜひ{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きたいです。
examples.english: I definitely want to go to Japan.

examples.japanese: {今度|こんど}の{週末|しゅうまつ}、ぜひ{遊|あそ}びに{来|き}てください。
examples.english: Please do come over to hang out this weekend.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}はとてもおもしろいので、ぜひ{読|よ}んでみてください。{人生|じんせい}が{変|か}わりますよ。
examples.english: This book is really interesting, so you should definitely read it. It will change your life.

notes:
ぜひ is an adverb that adds strong emphasis to requests, invitations, and expressions of desire. It conveys sincerity and earnestness.

KANJI:
Can be written as {是非|ぜひ} but hiragana is more common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ぜひ～てください: please do ~
- ぜひ～たい: definitely want to ~
- ぜひ{来|き}てください: please do come
- ぜひ{試|ため}してみてください: you should definitely try it

USAGE:
Used to make invitations, requests, and recommendations more sincere and emphatic. Often appears in polite speech.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- どうぞ: please (offering)
- どうか: please (requesting earnestly)
- きっと: surely, definitely

NOTE:
ぜひ also has a noun meaning of 'right and wrong' ({是非|ぜひ}を{問|と}う - to question right and wrong), but the adverbial use is far more common.
